body.message:
Unfortunately, we are unable to confirm the early check-in at this stage, as your booking has not yet been confirmed.

Once you complete the booking and payment, we will submit the early check-in request to the team on your behalf. Before the booking is confirmed, we are unable to request or guarantee an early check-in.

If you would like to proceed with the booking and make the payment, please let us know, and we will assist you with the next steps.
